title: acer amplum subsp. catalpifolium
intro: Acer amplum subsp. catalpifolium, commonly known as the Catalpa tree, is a deciduous tree native to China, characterized by its large leaves and showy flowers. The leaves and bark of the Catalpa tree have been used in traditional Chinese medicine for their health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer amplum subsp. catalpifolium include treating fever, sore throat, and digestive issues, as well as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
